foodMatrices.name: Raw Concord Grape Juice & Anthocyanin Extract (16.0° to 62.0° Brix, High Polyphenol)

foodMatrices.name: Specialty Cold-Brew Coffee Extract (5.0° to 35.0° Brix, High Volatile Pyrazines)

drawSolutions.name: Food-Grade Sodium Chloride Brine (NaCl, 3.5 to 5.0 M, Δπ = 175 to 260 bar)
drawSolutions.soluteType: Inorganic Electrolyte (High Diffusion, High Osmotic Pressure)
drawSolutions.reverseSaltFluxRisk: Moderate to High: Reverse NaCl flux into food stream must remain < 0.35 g/L to prevent perceptible salty taste.
drawSolutions.reconcentrationMethod: Thermal MVR Evaporator or High-Pressure Brackish RO Loop
drawSolutions.description: Widely utilized industrial draw solute delivering high water flux due to small hydrated radius and rapid diffusion inside support pores, requiring tight active polyamide layers to suppress reverse sodium leakage.

drawSolutions.name: Food-Grade Magnesium Chloride (MgCl2, 2.0 to 3.5 M, Δπ = 190 to 330 bar)
drawSolutions.soluteType: Divalent Inorganic Electrolyte (Low Reverse Permeation, Extreme Osmotic Driving Force)
drawSolutions.reverseSaltFluxRisk: Low: Hydrated divalent Mg2+ cations have strong electrostatic repulsion against negatively charged polyamide TFC layers, reducing Js/Jw by 60%.
drawSolutions.reconcentrationMethod: High-Pressure RO or Forward Evaporative Crystallization
drawSolutions.description: High-performance draw solute generating immense osmotic pressure (up to 330 bar) while significantly reducing reverse salt contamination due to the large steric hydrated diameter and multivalent charge of Mg2+.

drawSolutions.name: High-Fructose Corn Syrup / Sucrose (HFCS-55 / Sucrose 60° to 68° Brix, Δπ = 80 to 135 bar)
drawSolutions.soluteType: Organic Carbohydrate Draw Solute (100% Food-Grade, Zero Off-Flavor Risk)
drawSolutions.reverseSaltFluxRisk: Negligible: Trace reverse diffusion is purely sucrose/fructose, naturally occurring in juices; zero regulatory or taste penalty.
drawSolutions.description: Completely food-safe organic draw solute eliminating all risks of saline or mineral contamination; however, low diffusivity (D = 0.52e-9 m2/s) and high syrup viscosity induce substantial internal concentration polarization (ICP).

drawSolutions.name: Sanitary Potassium Citrate Buffer (K3C6H5O7, 1.8 to 2.8 M, Δπ = 110 to 185 bar)
drawSolutions.soluteType: Organic Acid Salt (Native Fruit Buffer, Low Reverse Risk)
drawSolutions.reverseSaltFluxRisk: Very Low: Citrate anions are bulky organic ions with high rejection; potassium and citrate are natural juice components with buffering capacity.
drawSolutions.description: Specialized food-contact draw solute that matches natural fruit juice acidity profiles, providing safe high-osmotic drive without altering the product's organoleptic mineral balance.

regulatoryStandards.title: Reverse Osmosis and Forward Osmosis Membrane Food-Contact Substances
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Membrane components (polyamide, polysulfone, polyester support backing, epoxy glues) must comply with total organic extractables limits (< 0.05 mg/in2 in food simulant) and withstand sanitary wash chemicals.

regulatoryStandards.title: Sanitary Standards for Crossflow Membrane Separation Systems for Liquid Milk and Food Products
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Fully drainable sanitary piping, zero dead-legs (L/D < 2), crevice-free sanitary tri-clamp fittings, and validated automated Clean-in-Place (CIP) cycle verification.

regulatoryStandards.title: Plastic Materials and Articles Intended to Come into Contact with Food
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Specific Migration Limits (SML) on monomers, crosslinkers (m-phenylenediamine, trimesoyl chloride), and plasticizers; overall migration must not exceed 10 mg/dm2.

regulatoryStandards.title: General Standard for Fruit Juices and Nectars
regulatoryStandards.requirement: Concentrated juices must maintain authentic sensory, chemical, and nutritional characteristics without mineral salt adulteration from processing aids.
